prompt:
Repaint this image in EXACTLY the hand-painted style of a Pillars of Eternity 2: Deadfire pre-rendered isometric background: visible oil-brush strokes, cool stone palette with warm fire-core accents, warm-core/cool-periphery chiaroscuro pooled at the braziers, DEEP BLUE-VIOLET cool shadows (never flat black) graded into every corner, a soft atmospheric falloff at the room edges, varied hand-worked texture on every stone plane (no repeated block pattern). FEATURE COUNTS (strict): EXACTLY ONE stone pillar, EXACTLY THREE braziers, EXACTLY FOUR arched doorways (BACK (north) wall + LEFT (west) wall + RIGHT (east) wall + FRONT (south) wall); every other wall surface is unbroken solid — NO other doorways, arches, gates or openings, NO other pillars or columns. NEGATIVE (strict): there is NO altar, NO shrine, NO carved stone chest or table anywhere in this room — the only stone masses are the pillar(s), the braziers' iron stands and the wall masonry; do NOT add furniture that is not in the input image. SINGLE FLAT LEVEL (strict): the floor is ONE SINGLE FLAT LEVEL — NO sunken areas, NO water channels, cisterns, pools or canals, NO staircases DOWN, NO pits or lower levels; every floor cell shown in the input stays dry, flat walkable floor. ROOM SHAPE (strict): the chamber is roughly SQUARE — about as wide as it is deep; preserve the input image's exact room proportions, floor extent and camera framing (the output must overlay the input). DOOR WALLS (strict): the FOUR arched doorways are in the BACK (north) wall and the LEFT (west) wall and the RIGHT (east) wall and the FRONT (south) wall; every other wall surface is unbroken solid with NO openings. BRAZIER PLACEMENT (strict): the THREE braziers stand: back half, west-of-centre; mid-depth, east-of-centre; front half, west-of-centre — exactly where the input image shows them; do NOT move them.

CRITICAL STRUCTURE-LOCK (non-negotiable, checked pixel-by-pixel against the original): every wall, pillar, archway, doorway, staircase, and prop must stay in EXACTLY its current position, size, and shape — do NOT move, add, remove, resize, or recompose ANYTHING; only the paint and lighting treatment changes. Keep the exact same isometric dimetric camera. Do NOT introduce any repeated, cloned, or tiled decorative motifs. Do NOT add any text, letters, numbers, labels, legends, map insets, UI elements, frames, or borders. Do NOT add any characters, people, figures, or creatures. The dark area outside the room walls stays dark empty background — add nothing there, no bones, objects, or debris outside the room. Do NOT add any staircases, steps, balconies, galleries, railings, mezzanines, or upper floors ANYWHERE — this is a strictly SINGLE-STOREY room and every empty corner stays an empty corner (measured defect: invented staircases on 3/3 prior rooms). Preserve the EXACT COUNT and PLACEMENT of every architectural feature from the input image: the same number of pillars/columns on the same floor positions, and the same number of wall openings/doorways/arches in the same walls. Do NOT add pillars, columns, doorways, arches, gates, portcullises, niches or alcoves that are not present in the input image; walls that are solid in the input stay unbroken solid. The floor is a SINGLE FLAT LEVEL: no sunken areas, no water channels, cisterns, pools or canals, no staircases DOWN, no pits or lower levels — every floor cell shown in the input stays dry, flat walkable floor in its ORIGINAL material.
